As a six-week summer course, I spent two hours in lecture, two hours in the laboratory, and another two hours studying on my own for four days a week for six weeks. No matter how many hours I spent studying, I couldn’t keep up. But instead of giving up, I picked up certain strategies like reading the material the night before, rewriting my notes, and joining a study group; eventually working my way up to a B.

samples.excerpt_start: K-nearest neighbor is well known
samples.text: K-nearest neighbor is well known for its classification algorithms. K-nearest neighbor is often referred to as memory-based learning or instance-based learning. Many people use this system because it helps to solve both classification and regression problems making it easier to solve and ultimately causing less stress. Backpropagation neural networks is another important system in which it is the practice of fine-tuning the weights of a neural net, basically ensuring lower error rates. While this may seem smooth, there can also be some disadvantages of backpropagation neural networks like for instance, the actual performance on a specific problem is dependent on the input data and also the back propagation algorithm in data mining can be quite sensitive to noisy data. The limitations of k-nearest neighbors is that it does not work well with a large data set and it does not work well with a high number of dimensions. For this research,the performance of backpropagation neural networks will be compared to classical machine learning to study which is more effective and would ultimately be more reliable. We predict that backpropagation neural networks will be less efficient/effective compared to k-nearest neighbors because although backpropagation ensures lower error rates, k-nearest neighbors helps with memory-based learning so people will be able to grasp more information. In the next section I will be discussing the impacts of my research and how it will be useful.
